title: Fraction of hidden width needed by Qwen mappings

scope.omitted_checkpoint: Qwen2.5-7B anchor: no Artificial Analysis index in the parent panel

rank_definition: minimum coefficient-TSVD rank with validation R2 within 0.02 of the full reconstructed map, divided by hidden dimension
caveats: Most Artificial Analysis values in this panel are estimates.
